sentences.en: Long ago, a troll made a mirror.
sentences.tgt: Il:o y:o avait:v autrefois:a un:o troll:o qui:o fabriqua:v un:o miroir:n .:o

sentences.en: This troll loved to trick and laugh at people.
sentences.tgt: Ce:o troll:o aimait:v tromper:v et:o se:o moquer:v des:o gens:n .:o

sentences.en: The mirror changed how things looked.
sentences.tgt: Le:o miroir:n changeait:v l':o apparence:n des:o choses:n .:o

sentences.en: Good things looked bad in the mirror.
sentences.tgt: Les:o bonnes:a choses:n semblaient:v mauvaises:a dans:o le:o miroir:n .:o

sentences.en: A kind face looked cruel in the mirror.
sentences.tgt: Un:o visage:n aimable:a semblait:v cruel:a dans:o le:o miroir:n .:o

sentences.en: The mirror made bad things look worse.
sentences.tgt: Le:o miroir:n faisait:v paraître:v les:o mauvaises:a choses:n encore:a pires:a .:o

sentences.en: The troll carried the mirror from town to town.
sentences.tgt: Le:o troll:o porta:v le:o miroir:n de:o ville:n en:o ville:n .:o

sentences.en: He looked at what the mirror showed and laughed.
sentences.tgt: Il:o regardait:v ce:o que:o le:o miroir:n montrait:v et:o riait:v .:o

sentences.en: One day, the troll climbed a mountain with the mirror.
sentences.tgt: Un:o jour:n ,:o le:o troll:o gravit:v une:o montagne:n avec:o le:o miroir:n .:o

sentences.en: He held the mirror up to look at the whole world.
sentences.tgt: Il:o leva:v le:o miroir:n pour:o regarder:v le:o monde:n entier:a .:o

sentences.en: The mirror grew heavy in his hands.
sentences.tgt: Le:o miroir:n devint:v lourd:a dans:o ses:o mains:n .:o

sentences.en: It slipped and fell.
sentences.tgt: Il:o glissa:v et:o tomba:v .:o

sentences.en: The mirror broke into small splinters on the rocks.
sentences.tgt: Le:o miroir:n se:o brisa:v en:o petits:a éclats:n sur:o les:o rochers:n .:o

sentences.en: A cold wind carried the splinters across the world.
sentences.tgt: Un:o vent:n froid:a porta:v les:o éclats:n à:o travers:o le:o monde:n .:o

sentences.en: A splinter in the eye made everything look bad.
sentences.tgt: Un:o éclat:n dans:o l':o œil:n faisait:v tout:o paraître:v mauvais:a .:o

sentences.en: A splinter in the heart made it cold.
sentences.tgt: Un:o éclat:n dans:o le:o cœur:n le:o rendait:v froid:a .:o

sentences.en: In a small town, Kai and Gerda lived in two houses, side by side.
sentences.tgt: Dans:o une:o petite:a ville:n ,:o Kai:o et:o Gerda:o vivaient:v dans:o deux:o maisons:n ,:o côte:n à:o côte:n .:o

sentences.en: Each house had a box of roses by its window.
sentences.tgt: Chaque:o maison:n avait:v une:o caisse:n de:o roses:n près:o de:o sa:o fenêtre:n .:o

sentences.en: The two boxes had a board between them.
sentences.tgt: Les:o deux:o caisses:n avaient:v une:o planche:n entre:o elles:o .:o

sentences.en: Kai and Gerda climbed across the board each day.
sentences.tgt: Kai:o et:o Gerda:o traversaient:v la:o planche:n chaque:o jour:n .:o

sentences.en: They loved each other like brother and sister.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o s':o aimaient:v comme:o frère:n et:o sœur:n .:o

sentences.en: In winter, Kai's grandmother told them of the Snow Queen by the fire.
sentences.tgt: En:o hiver:n ,:o la:o grand-mère:n de:o Kai:o leur:o parla:v de:o la:o Reine:n des:o Neiges:n près:o du:o feu:n .:o

sentences.en: The Snow Queen lived in the snow and cold.
sentences.tgt: La:o Reine:n des:o Neiges:n vivait:v dans:o la:o neige:n et:o le:o froid:n .:o

sentences.en: "She looked in at windows and made them cold with frost," said grandmother.
sentences.tgt: «:o Elle:o regardait:v par:o les:o fenêtres:n et:o les:o rendait:v froides:a avec:o le:o givre:n ,:o »:o dit:v grand-mère:n .:o

sentences.en: "She had a palace of ice, up in the north," grandmother said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Elle:o avait:v un:o palais:n de:o glace:n ,:o là-haut:a dans:o le:o nord:n ,:o »:o dit:v grand-mère:n .:o

sentences.en: Kai looked at the frost on his window.
sentences.tgt: Kai:o regarda:v le:o givre:n sur:o sa:o fenêtre:n .:o

sentences.en: Kai said he would put the Snow Queen by the warm fire.
sentences.tgt: Kai:o dit:v qu':o il:o mettrait:v la:o Reine:n des:o Neiges:n près:o du:o feu:n chaud:a .:o

sentences.en: Gerda laughed at this.
sentences.tgt: Gerda:o rit:v de:o cela:o .:o

sentences.en: Kai and Gerda looked at their roses each day.
sentences.tgt: Kai:o et:o Gerda:o regardaient:v leurs:o roses:n chaque:o jour:n .:o

sentences.en: One cold winter night, Kai sat by his small window.
sentences.tgt: Un:o froid:a soir:n d':o hiver:n ,:o Kai:o était:v assis:a près:o de:o sa:o petite:a fenêtre:n .:o

sentences.en: A cold wind blew a small splinter into Kai's eye.
sentences.tgt: Un:o vent:n froid:a souffla:v une:o petite:a éclat:n dans:o l':o œil:n de:o Kai:o .:o

sentences.en: Kai rubbed his eye with his hand, but the splinter stayed.
sentences.tgt: Kai:o se:o frotta:v l':o œil:n avec:o sa:o main:n ,:o mais:o l':o éclat:n resta:v .:o

sentences.en: That night, another splinter went into Kai's heart, and it stayed.
sentences.tgt: Cette:o nuit-là:n ,:o une:o autre:o éclat:n entra:v dans:o le:o cœur:n de:o Kai:o ,:o et:o elle:o y:o resta:v .:o

sentences.en: The splinter in his eye made Kai see only what was bad.
sentences.tgt: L':o éclat:n dans:o son:o œil:n fit:v Kai:o voir:v seulement:a ce:o qui:o était:v mauvais:a .:o

sentences.en: The splinter in his heart made it cold, like the wind and the snow.
sentences.tgt: L':o éclat:n dans:o son:o cœur:n le:o rendit:v froid:a ,:o comme:o le:o vent:n et:o la:o neige:n .:o

sentences.en: Kai's heart was cold like the snow, so he no longer loved Gerda.
sentences.tgt: Le:o cœur:n de:o Kai:o était:v froid:a comme:o la:o neige:n ,:o alors:o il:o n':o aimait:v plus:o Gerda:o .:o

sentences.en: That day, Kai looked at Gerda's roses and said they were bad.
sentences.tgt: Ce:o jour-là:o ,:o Kai:o regarda:v les:o roses:n de:o Gerda:o et:o dit:v qu':o elles:o étaient:v mauvaises:a .:o

sentences.en: He pulled the roses from their box and threw them.
sentences.tgt: Il:o arracha:v les:o roses:n de:o leur:o boîte:n et:o les:o jeta:v .:o

sentences.en: "Stop!" Gerda said to Kai, but Kai only laughed.
sentences.tgt: «:o Arrête:v !:o »:o dit:v Gerda:o à:o Kai:o ,:o mais:o Kai:o ne:o fit:v que:o rire:v .:o

sentences.en: Gerda did not want this bad change, but Kai would not stop.
sentences.tgt: Gerda:o ne:o voulait:v pas:o ce:o mauvais:a changement:n ,:o mais:o Kai:o ne:o voulait:v pas:o s':o arrêter:v .:o

sentences.en: Kai no longer wanted to sit by the roses with Gerda.
sentences.tgt: Kai:o ne:o voulait:v plus:o s':o asseoir:v près:o des:o roses:n avec:o Gerda:o .:o

sentences.en: Gerda did not know why Kai had changed.
sentences.tgt: Gerda:o ne:o savait:v pas:o pourquoi:o Kai:o avait:v changé:v .:o

sentences.en: Winter came, and snow lay on the town.
sentences.tgt: L':o hiver:n arriva:v ,:o et:o la:o neige:n recouvrit:v la:o ville:n .:o

sentences.en: Boys carried their sleds to the town square.
sentences.tgt: Des:o garçons:n portèrent:v leurs:o luges:n à:o la:o place:n de:o la:o ville:n .:o

sentences.en: Kai went to the square with his sled.
sentences.tgt: Kai:o alla:v à:o la:o place:n avec:o sa:o traîneau:n .:o

sentences.en: A white sledge came fast into the square.
sentences.tgt: Un:o grand:a traîneau:n blanc:a entra:v rapidement:a dans:o la:o place:n .:o

sentences.en: A driver in white fur sat in the sledge.
sentences.tgt: Un:o conducteur:n en:o fourrure:n blanche:a était:v assis:a dans:o le:o traîneau:n .:o

sentences.en: Kai tied his sled to the white sledge.
sentences.tgt: Kai:o attacha:v sa:o traîneau:n au:o grand:a traîneau:n blanc:a .:o

sentences.en: The sledge flew out of the square and into the town.
sentences.tgt: Le:o traîneau:n s':o élança:v hors:o de:o la:o place:n et:o dans:o la:o ville:n .:o

sentences.en: Kai wanted to go home, afraid of the fast ride.
sentences.tgt: Kai:o voulait:v rentrer:v chez:o lui:o ,:o effrayé:a par:o la:o course:n rapide:a .:o

sentences.en: He thought of his warm house and grandmother by the fire.
sentences.tgt: Il:o pensa:v à:o sa:o maison:n chaude:a et:o à:o sa:o grand-mère:n près:o du:o feu:n .:o

sentences.en: The sledge went out of the town, into the snow.
sentences.tgt: Le:o traîneau:n sortit:v de:o la:o ville:n ,:o dans:o la:o neige:n .:o

sentences.en: Kai's hands were too cold to move, and the cold wind hurt his face.
sentences.tgt: Les:o mains:n de:o Kai:o étaient:v trop:a froides:a pour:o bouger:v ,:o et:o le:o vent:n froid:a blessa:v son:o visage:n .:o

sentences.en: Kai called out, afraid, but no one heard him.
sentences.tgt: Kai:o cria:v ,:o effrayé:a ,:o mais:o personne:o ne:o l':o entendit:v .:o

sentences.en: The sledge stopped, and the driver looked at Kai.
sentences.tgt: Le:o traîneau:n s':o arrêta:v ,:o et:o le:o conducteur:n regarda:v Kai:o .:o

sentences.en: The driver was the Snow Queen, in white fur.
sentences.tgt: Le:o conducteur:n était:v la:o Reine:n des:o Neiges:n ,:o en:o fourrure:n blanche:a .:o

sentences.en: Her eyes were as cold as the snow and the wind.
sentences.tgt: Ses:o yeux:n étaient:v aussi:a froids:a que:o la:o neige:n et:o le:o vent:n .:o

sentences.en: The Snow Queen put Kai into her sledge and wrapped him in fur.
sentences.tgt: La:o Reine:n des:o Neiges:n mit:v Kai:o dans:o son:o traîneau:n et:o l':o enveloppa:v dans:o de:o la:o fourrure:n .:o

sentences.en: In the cold night, the Snow Queen kissed Kai, and the cold left him.
sentences.tgt: Dans:o la:o froide:a nuit:n ,:o la:o Reine:n des:o Neiges:n embrassa:v Kai:o ,:o et:o le:o froid:n le:o quitta:v .:o

sentences.en: The kiss made Kai forget Gerda, his grandmother, and his warm home.
sentences.tgt: Le:o baiser:n fit:v oublier:v à:o Kai:o Gerda:o ,:o sa:o grand-mère:n ,:o et:o sa:o maison:n chaude:a .:o

sentences.en: The sledge flew north, and Kai was gone from the cold town.
sentences.tgt: Le:o traîneau:n vola:v vers:o le:o nord:n ,:o et:o Kai:o avait:v disparu:v de:o la:o froide:a ville:n .:o

sentences.en: Grandmother and Gerda stayed by day and by night, but Kai did not come home.
sentences.tgt: Grand-mère:n et:o Gerda:o attendirent:v jour:n et:o nuit:n ,:o mais:o Kai:o ne:o rentra:v pas:o .:o

sentences.en: People in the cold town said that Kai had fallen and was gone from home.
sentences.tgt: Les:o gens:n de:o la:o froide:a ville:n dirent:v que:o Kai:o était:v tombé:v et:o avait:v disparu:v de:o chez:o lui:o .:o

sentences.en: Gerda did not believe this, for she had not seen it.
sentences.tgt: Gerda:o ne:o crut:v pas:o cela:o ,:o car:o elle:o ne:o l':o avait:v pas:o vu:v .:o

sentences.en: Spring came, and the snow melted from the town and the small house.
sentences.tgt: Le:o printemps:n arriva:v ,:o et:o la:o neige:n fondit:v sur:o la:o ville:n et:o la:o petite:a maison:n .:o

sentences.en: Their roses bloomed in the window boxes that spring.
sentences.tgt: Leurs:o roses:n fleurirent:v dans:o les:o jardinières:n de:o fenêtre:n ce:o printemps-là:o .:o

sentences.en: Gerda looked at the roses in the window and thought of Kai and of home.
sentences.tgt: Gerda:o regarda:v les:o roses:n dans:o la:o fenêtre:n et:o pensa:v à:o Kai:o et:o à:o la:o maison:n .:o

sentences.en: "I will go and find Kai now," Gerda said to grandmother by the fire.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o vais:v aller:v trouver:v Kai:o maintenant:a ,:o »:o dit:v Gerda:o à:o grand-mère:n près:o du:o feu:n .:o

sentences.en: Grandmother did not think Gerda would find Kai.
sentences.tgt: Grand-mère:n ne:o pensait:v pas:o que:o Gerda:o trouverait:v Kai:o .:o

sentences.en: Gerda put on warm clothes and left the small house alone that cold day.
sentences.tgt: Gerda:o mit:v des:o vêtements:n chauds:a et:o quitta:v la:o petite:a maison:n seule:a ce:o jour-là:o froid:a .:o

sentences.en: She went for days, north, into the cold snow, to look for Kai.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o marcha:v pendant:o des:o jours:n ,:o vers:o le:o nord:n ,:o dans:o la:o neige:n froide:a ,:o pour:o chercher:v Kai:o .:o

sentences.en: Gerda walked on and came to a great town with a palace.
sentences.tgt: Gerda:o continua:v à:o marcher:v et:o arriva:v dans:o une:o grande:a ville:n avec:o un:o palais:n .:o

sentences.en: Gerda had walked for many days, and she was tired and cold.
sentences.tgt: Gerda:o avait:v marché:v pendant:o de:o nombreux:a jours:n ,:o et:o elle:o était:v fatiguée:a et:o froide:a .:o

sentences.en: That night, Gerda went into the palace to look for Kai.
sentences.tgt: Ce:o soir-là:a ,:o Gerda:o entra:v dans:o le:o palais:n pour:o chercher:v Kai:o .:o

sentences.en: She came to a room where a prince and princess were asleep.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o arriva:v dans:o une:o pièce:n où:o un:o prince:n et:o une:o princesse:n dormaient:v .:o

sentences.en: Gerda called out for Kai, and the prince and princess woke.
sentences.tgt: Gerda:o appela:v Kai:o ,:o et:o le:o prince:n et:o la:o princesse:n se:o réveillèrent:v .:o

sentences.en: But the prince was not Kai, only a boy that looked like him.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o le:o prince:n n':o était:v pas:o Kai:o ,:o seulement:a un:o garçon:n qui:o lui:o ressemblait:v .:o

sentences.en: Gerda told the prince and princess about Kai and the Snow Queen.
sentences.tgt: Gerda:o parla:v au:o prince:n et:o à:o la:o princesse:n de:o Kai:o et:o de:o la:o Reine:n des:o Neiges:n .:o

sentences.en: The prince and princess were kind, and they listened to her tale.
sentences.tgt: Le:o prince:n et:o la:o princesse:n étaient:v aimables:a ,:o et:o ils:o écoutèrent:v son:o récit:n .:o

sentences.en: They believed her tale of the cold Snow Queen.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o crurent:v son:o récit:n de:o la:o froide:a Reine:n des:o Neiges:n .:o

sentences.en: The next day, they gave Gerda warm clothes for her walk north.
sentences.tgt: Le:o lendemain:n ,:o ils:o donnèrent:v à:o Gerda:o des:o vêtements:n chauds:a pour:o sa:o marche:n vers:o le:o nord:n .:o

sentences.en: They gave her a golden coach to ride north, too.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o lui:o donnèrent:v aussi:a un:o carrosse:n doré:a pour:o voyager:v vers:o le:o nord:n .:o

sentences.en: Gerda thanked the prince and princess and rode north in the coach.
sentences.tgt: Gerda:o remercia:v le:o prince:n et:o la:o princesse:n et:o repartit:v vers:o le:o nord:n dans:o le:o carrosse:n .:o

sentences.en: The golden coach carried Gerda north, into the cold and snow.
sentences.tgt: Le:o carrosse:n doré:a porta:v Gerda:o vers:o le:o nord:n ,:o dans:o le:o froid:n et:o la:o neige:n .:o

sentences.en: The golden coach went into a forest, and Gerda was cold and afraid.
sentences.tgt: Le:o carrosse:n doré:a entra:v dans:o une:o forêt:n ,:o et:o Gerda:o avait:v froid:a et:o peur:n .:o

sentences.en: Many robbers came out of the dark forest and stopped the coach.
sentences.tgt: Beaucoup:o de:o brigands:n sortirent:v de:o la:o sombre:a forêt:n et:o arrêtèrent:v le:o carrosse:n .:o

sentences.en: An old robber woman looked into the coach at Gerda.
sentences.tgt: Une:o vieille:a femme:n brigand:n regarda:v dans:o le:o carrosse:n vers:o Gerda:o .:o

sentences.en: She pulled out a long knife to hurt Gerda for the golden coach.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o sortit:v un:o long:a couteau:n pour:o blesser:v Gerda:o à:o cause:n du:o carrosse:n doré:a .:o

sentences.en: But the old robber woman had a daughter.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o la:o vieille:a femme:n brigand:n avait:v une:o fille:n .:o

sentences.en: The daughter was a rough girl that carried a knife.
sentences.tgt: La:o fille:n était:v une:o fille:n rude:a qui:o portait:v un:o couteau:n .:o

sentences.en: "Stop! I want her!" the daughter said to her mother.
sentences.tgt: «:o Arrête:v !:o Je:o la:o veux:v !:o »:o dit:v -elle:o à:o sa:o mère:n .:o

sentences.en: The daughter stopped her mother's knife with her hand.
sentences.tgt: La:o fille:n arrêta:v le:o couteau:n de:o sa:o mère:n avec:o sa:o main:n .:o

sentences.en: The robber girl was rough, but she smiled at Gerda.
sentences.tgt: La:o fille:n brigand:n était:v rude:a ,:o mais:o elle:o sourit:v à:o Gerda:o .:o

sentences.en: The robber girl had Gerda now, not her old mother.
sentences.tgt: La:o fille:n brigand:n avait:v Gerda:o maintenant:a ,:o pas:o sa:o vieille:a mère:n .:o

sentences.en: The old robber woman did not want this, but she let Gerda go.
sentences.tgt: La:o vieille:a femme:n brigand:n ne:o voulait:v pas:o cela:o ,:o mais:o elle:o laissa:v Gerda:o partir:v .:o

sentences.en: The robber girl led Gerda to a castle in the forest.
sentences.tgt: La:o fille:n du:o brigand:n conduisit:v Gerda:o à:o un:o château:n dans:o la:o forêt:n .:o

sentences.en: "You will live with me in this castle now," the robber girl said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Tu:o vivras:v avec:o moi:o dans:o ce:o château:n maintenant:a ,:o »:o dit:v la:o fille:n du:o brigand:n .:o

sentences.en: Night fell as they came to the castle, and Gerda stayed close to the girl.
sentences.tgt: La:o nuit:n tomba:v quand:o ils:o arrivèrent:v au:o château:n ,:o et:o Gerda:o resta:v près:a de:o la:o fille:n .:o

sentences.en: The robber girl's castle held many robbers.
sentences.tgt: Le:o château:n de:o la:o fille:n du:o brigand:n abritait:v beaucoup:a de:o brigands:n .:o

sentences.en: The robber girl led Gerda to a corner of the castle.
sentences.tgt: La:o fille:n du:o brigand:n conduisit:v Gerda:o dans:o un:o coin:n du:o château:n .:o

sentences.en: She kept many animals in this castle, from the forest.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o gardait:v beaucoup:a d':o animaux:n dans:o ce:o château:n ,:o venus:a de:o la:o forêt:n .:o

sentences.en: Wood pigeons sat in a cage in the castle.
sentences.tgt: Des:o pigeons:n ramiers:a étaient:v assis:a dans:o une:o cage:n dans:o le:o château:n .:o

sentences.en: A reindeer stood tied by a rope in the corner.
sentences.tgt: Un:o renne:n se:o tenait:v attaché:a par:o une:o corde:n dans:o le:o coin:n .:o

sentences.en: "The reindeer came from the north," the robber girl said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Le:o renne:n venait:v du:o nord:n ,:o »:o dit:v la:o fille:n du:o brigand:n .:o

sentences.en: She held her knife near the reindeer, and it did not move.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o tint:v son:o couteau:n près:a du:o renne:n ,:o et:o il:o ne:o bougea:v pas:o .:o

sentences.en: That night, Gerda and the robber girl lay on a bed of straw.
sentences.tgt: Cette:o nuit-là:a ,:o Gerda:o et:o la:o fille:n du:o brigand:n s':o allongèrent:v sur:o un:o lit:n de:o paille:n .:o

sentences.en: The robber girl kept her knife in her hand, near Gerda, that night.
sentences.tgt: La:o fille:n du:o brigand:n garda:v son:o couteau:n dans:o sa:o main:n ,:o près:o de:o Gerda:o ,:o cette:o nuit-là:o .:o

sentences.en: "If anyone comes near you, I will use this," she said to Gerda.
sentences.tgt: «:o Si:o quelqu':o un:o s':o approche:v de:o toi:o ,:o j':o utiliserai:v ceci:o »:o ,:o dit:v -elle:o à:o Gerda:o .:o

sentences.en: Gerda was afraid to move in this castle, but not afraid of the robber girl.
sentences.tgt: Gerda:o avait:v peur:n de:o bouger:v dans:o ce:o château:n ,:o mais:o n':o avait:v pas:o peur:n de:o la:o fille:n du:o brigand:n .:o

sentences.en: "Why do you want to find this boy?" the robber girl asked.
sentences.tgt: «:o Pourquoi:o veux:v -tu:o trouver:v ce:o garçon:n ?:o »:o demanda:v la:o fille:n du:o brigand:n .:o

sentences.en: Gerda told her of Kai, the splinters, and the Snow Queen's sledge that night.

sentences.en: The next day, Gerda asked the wood pigeons if they had seen Kai.

sentences.en: "The robbers tied me in this castle," the reindeer said.

sentences.en: Gerda thanked the robber girl and the reindeer for her help, and her mittens.

sentences.en: "Go and find your Kai," the robber girl said, and smiled.

sentences.en: The reindeer ran out of the castle and into the forest, to the north.

sentences.en: Gerda put on the warm mittens from the robber girl, and was not afraid.

sentences.en: "The lights come from the cold north, from the Snow Queen," the reindeer said.

sentences.en: "I saw her palace of ice," he said.

sentences.en: "Come inside, out of the cold," she said.

sentences.en: Gerda told her the tale, from the mirror to the Snow Queen.

sentences.en: "The Snow Queen's palace is many cold days north," she said.

sentences.en: "Kai sits in that palace now, his heart cold from the splinter," she said.

sentences.en: "Will you give Gerda magic to help her?" the reindeer asked.

sentences.en: "I have no more power to give her," the wise woman said.

sentences.en: "Her strength is her loving heart," said the wise woman.

sentences.en: "That is more than any magic in the north," she said.

sentences.en: "Leave her before the palace," she told the reindeer.

sentences.en: The reindeer thanked her, and they went on into the cold.

sentences.en: The reindeer ran for two more days, and the cold grew worse and worse.

sentences.en: Gerda climbed down and thanked the reindeer, and he stopped there in the cold.

sentences.en: Gerda called out for Kai, but no one called back.

sentences.en: She walked from room to room in the palace to look for Kai.

sentences.en: Kai sat alone on the frozen lake.

sentences.en: Many pieces of ice lay by him, and Kai moved them, one by one.

sentences.en: The Snow Queen had made Kai a promise.

sentences.en: Kai had to form one word to go free.

sentences.en: Kai did not remember the Snow Queen, or the ice palace.

sentences.en: The word was "forever."

sentences.en: "We must go before the Snow Queen comes back," Gerda said.

sentences.en: Kai took Gerda's hand, and they ran out of the palace.

sentences.en: Day by day, the snow grew thin.

sentences.en: Kai looked at Gerda and saw she had grown taller.

sentences.en: They had grown up, but in their hearts, they still felt like children.
